sourceCopy.name: Fisher Exact Test Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Fisher Exact Test Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate a two-sided or one-sided Fisher exact test for a 2×2 table. See margins, p-value and odds ratio for free in your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: Enter the four counts in a 2×2 table to calculate Fisher’s exact test with fixed margins.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: When should I use Fisher’s exact test?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It is an exact test of association for a 2×2 table, often used when expected counts are small. The result depends on the study design and does not prove causation.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser. Counts are not uploaded or stored by this tool.
howTo: Enter nonnegative whole-number counts in all four cells.
Choose the alternative before interpreting results.
Review the fixed margins, p-value, odds ratio and method note.

fields.notEstimable: Not estimable from these zero cells
fields.accuracyNote: Counts must be whole numbers. Maximum 10,000 per cell and 20,000 total. The two-sided test sums tables no more probable than the observed table under fixed margins.
fields.designNote: Choose a one-sided direction only when specified before examining the data. The odds ratio is the uncorrected cross-product ratio; zero cells may make it undefined or infinite. This is not a causal conclusion.
fields.formulaNote: The p-value is conditional on the observed row and column totals. It does not adjust for multiple tests, covariates or a complex sampling design.

messages.checkInputs: Check all four counts and the alternative hypothesis.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable in this browser.
messages.totalRange: The table total must be between 1 and 20,000.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the null hypothesis?
additionalFaqs.answer: The test evaluates whether the row and column classifications are independent, conditional on the observed margins. It does not explain why an association may exist.

additionalFaqs.question: How is a two-sided p-value calculated?
additionalFaqs.answer: This calculator adds probabilities of all possible tables with the same margins whose conditional probability is no greater than that of the observed table. Other software conventions can differ.

additionalFaqs.question: Does a small p-value prove an effect?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. A p-value is not an effect size or proof of causation. Review the odds ratio, study design, data quality, uncertainty and any multiple-testing plan.
